changes: Colourful scenes now need less processing, leaving more headroom for the LCD shader, audio, controls and interface without changing game timing.
The improvement is most useful in Pokémon battles, Wario Land scrolling areas, Shantae's sprite-heavy scenes and Pokémon Crystal menus.
Fresh-process measurements were +2.00% Super Mario Land, +4.12% Link's Awakening, +2.99% Pokémon Blue, +2.06% Wario Land 3, +3.28% Shantae and +4.27% Pokémon Crystal versus v2.2.1.
The measured frames and CPU state matched the previous release, and all 57 project tests still pass.
This is a performance release; the next major v3.0.0 milestone is reserved for broad PPU/APU accuracy gains with the same performance standard.
